name: Fatum-Obscurum
specific_features: Anomalous radio emissions from crater center
Perfectly spherical object buried beneath regolith
description: Fatum-Obscurum is a tiny worldlet orbiting at the extreme edge of its star system, so small that its gravity barely holds its own regolith in place. The surface is remarkably smooth for a body in the outer system, as though recently resurfaced, with only a single massive impact crater breaking the monotony of its gray plains. The crater dominates the northern hemisphere, its rim sharp and unweathered, its floor hidden in permanent shadow where temperatures approach absolute zero.

Without atmosphere or magnetic field, the surface is exposed to the full spectrum of interstellar radiation, a bombardment that should have darkened the regolith over billions of years. Instead, the surface material is unusually reflective, almost white, contributing to the anomalous appearance that first drew survey attention. In the vacuum, every footprint is permanent, every disturbance a mark that will persist until the sun itself dies. The isolation is profound, the nearest significant body millions of kilometers distant.

The anomalous radio emissions were detected during a routine system survey, a weak but structured signal emanating from the geometric center of the crater floor. Investigation revealed a perfectly spherical object approximately twelve meters in diameter, buried beneath three meters of regolith at the emission source. The object is composed of an alloy that resists all scanning methods, its interior opaque to every wavelength tested. It is warm, maintaining a temperature several degrees above its surroundings through no identifiable energy source.

The object has not been excavated, pending a decision by the Xenoarchaeological Authority on appropriate protocols. The radio emissions continue on a regular cycle, broadcasting a pattern that mathematical analysis suggests carries information content but which has resisted all decryption attempts. Some researchers argue the signal is a beacon, others that it is a warning. The object's presence on this otherwise insignificant body raises the question of whether it was placed here deliberately, hidden on a world so small and remote that only a thorough survey would find it, and what it might mean that someone clearly intended it to be found eventually.
